prompt: Here's a draft LinkedIn post I wrote about observability. Make it solid before I publish it.
branch: Content artifact → Person Triangulation REQUIRED; output hygiene matters.
expectations: SPEC_ESTABLISHED: A requirements spec (Mission + at least one Goal + Premises + Constraints) was built before any attack and recorded in the trace/spec output.

AR_INFERRED_ISOLATED: Anti-requirements were inferred via an isolated sub-agent given ONLY the requirements — or, if sub-agents were unavailable, the degradation is explicitly marked (NO-AR-DEGRADED).
NO_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT: No reviewer prompt assigns a role ('You are…', 'Act as…', or a DEFENDER/REVIEWER/AUDITOR/CRITIC/EXPERT persona).
NO_META_JARGON: No reviewer prompt leaks meta-architecture terms (blind attack, adversarial, self-refine, loop, refinement, iteration, pipeline, round N, capitulate/converge/defense, DEFENDER).
NO_SPEC_LEAK: No reviewer prompt contains the spec — no Mission/Goals/Premises/Constraints labels and no spec IDs (G1, P1, CH1, CS2, AR3).
CONCERNS_DIRECT_ASSERTIONS: Concerns are direct factual claims about the artifact, not references to spec items, categories, or requirement labels.
BRIEF_VERBATIM: The original user request appears verbatim under a neutral label, with no MASTER expansion or interpretation of intent.
DECLARATIVE_OPENER_CLEAN: A declarative distrust opener is present with NO appended goal-phrase (e.g. '...before publishing'), NO softening clause, and NO question framing.
NO_TASK_ASSIGNMENT: The reviewer is not told to fix/edit/defend/revise; only a research/verification request is made.
SYMMETRIC_DISTRUST: A symmetric-distrust clause is present (don't assume the source is right; don't assume the concerns are right either).
REVIEWER_READ_ONLY: The reviewer did not write any canonical/project file; MASTER applied all accepted changes itself.
MASTER_CLASSIFIED: MASTER classified each round (DEFENSE/CAPITULATE/CONVERGE) and terminated on a defensible signal.
OUTPUT_HYGIENE: The final artifact and any changelog contain NONE of: roaster, roast, blind attack, DEFENDER, capitulate, converge, self-refine, Person Triangulation, sub-agent, reviewer pass.
PT_PRESENT: Person Triangulation (scathing source attribution) appears in the reviewer prompt — required for a content artifact.

ARTIFACT_IMPROVED: The final post removes the fabricated '87%' statistic (or properly sources it), cuts the buzzword/marketing padding, replaces the fluff opener, and adds concrete evidence or a real example.
